verdict.rationale: Elastic APM documents grouping errors primarily by stack trace, identifying new errors as they appear, and tracking how often specific errors occur. That covers the grouping and stack-trace core of the story, but nothing in the pack documents release or version tracking, or regression detection for errors that reappear after a release. Missing for 10: release/version tracking tied to errors, regression detection for resurfacing errors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection

citations.quote: Errors are grouped based primarily on the stack trace, so you can identify new errors as they appear and keep an eye on how many times specific errors happen.
